basis: Official public program pages, provider help documents, and issuer financial disclosures. No private affiliate dashboard, customer data, or Seller Insider Hub affiliate approval is represented.
defaultPriceNote: The model's subscription price is an editable assumption about a referred customer's monthly spend. $100, $50, and other scenario prices are not vendor plan-price quotations.
modelNotes: Recurring commissions belong to an affiliate agreement. Seller Insider Hub does not own the vendors' subscription revenue or customer contracts.
Every maturity and sensitivity preset is illustrative. None is a measured result, probability-weighted forecast, investor return, or promise of passive earnings.

A month-level delay approximates approval, settlement, withdrawal, and bank processing. Day-specific schedules, annual upfront customer billing, and account-specific exceptions can change cash timing.

Payout thresholds are applied separately to each modeled program. Real Impact account balances may pool multiple brands, so the separate-program treatment can delay modeled withdrawals relative to a shared account.

payoutMinimumCustomers is a cumulative count of expected unique approved referrals after their modeled delay. It is not an active-customer requirement or a fresh referral count per payout. Exact account-level settlement rules still govern real withdrawals.
Conversion, eligibility, attribution, churn, reversal, average spend, and traffic assumptions require business evidence. They are not supplied by the public commission rate.

The eligibility/approval rate should incorporate expected attribution failures and required survival through a provider's lock. The model applies this expected approval at acquisition rather than evaluating each actual cancellation or refund against a vendor contract.

Model costs should include editorial maintenance, founder compensation, contractors, software, administration, and acquisition. A negative cash balance means additional funding is required; the model does not assume that funding is available.
Company benchmarks provide context about established businesses. Their revenue, profit, audience, and valuation must not be scaled mechanically into a Seller Insider Hub forecast.

programs.name: HubSpot
programs.summary: The publicly advertised Starter affiliate tier pays 30% recurring commission for up to one year. It is an application-based program with a 180-day cookie window.

terms.payoutSummary: Impact handles payments; the public program page states a $10 withdrawal minimum and EFT or PayPal. The applicable locking period is specified in the affiliate tool rather than as a universal number in the public policies.
terms.eligibility: Qualifying new customers must remain active through the lock. Existing customers, active sales opportunities, self-referrals, and serviced-client referrals can be ineligible.
terms.adjustments: The public policies exclude extra commission from subsequent upgrades; downgrades reduce the commission. Agreement eligibility and account terms govern payment.

caveats: Two months is an editable planning delay, not a publicly guaranteed HubSpot payout interval.
A 12-month term ends a cohort's commission even if that customer continues subscribing.
Higher affiliate tiers and cost-per-signup arrangements are not assumed.

programs.name: MailerLite
programs.summary: MailerLite advertises 30% recurring commission on referred customers' paid subscriptions for as long as they remain active, subject to affiliate eligibility. Its tracking cookie lasts 45 days.

terms.payoutSummary: Each sale has a 30-day refund hold. Settlement requires at least $100 in open balance from at least two separate referrals. Eligible balances settle on Fridays when payment and billing details are complete.
terms.eligibility: Applications are reviewed; a free account signup alone is not a paid referral.
terms.adjustments: The model applies an expected reversal haircut to commissions. Actual refunded or ineligible sales do not qualify for normal approved settlement.

caveats: One modeled month approximates the 30-day hold; Friday settlement, thresholds, and banking can extend cash timing.
Zero commission-expiry months means ongoing eligibility in the model, not an unconditional lifetime guarantee.
Expected fractional referrals approximate a threshold that actual accounts meet through whole qualifying referrals.

programs.name: Kit
programs.summary: Kit's base offer pays 50% of a referred paying customer's first 12 months of payments. Additional 10–20% commission after that first year requires qualifying for, and retaining, an affiliate status tier.

terms.payoutSummary: Kit's getting-started guide describes a 31-day refund period, subsequent monthly review, and withdrawal availability around the 13th through PartnerStack. A $5 minimum applies.
terms.eligibility: Base first-year commissions apply to paying referrals. The ongoing Bronze, Silver, and Gold rates are conditional. Paid-promotion referrals do not count toward status qualification.
terms.adjustments: Refund review precedes payout. A customer continuing after month 12 does not automatically extend the base 50% commission.

caveats: The model uses only the base offer; conditional post-year-one status commissions are excluded.

The getting-started guide's example has a July 4 transaction available around September 13 after the hold and review. The FAQ describes review of commissions earned in the previous month without fully repeating that hold. Two months is a planning approximation, not a bank-date guarantee.
No numeric cookie window was established from the current official pages reviewed.

programs.name: Semrush SEO Toolkit
programs.summary: The published base table lists a $200 commission for a new SEO Toolkit sale. This is a one-time referral payment, not recurring subscription revenue.

terms.payoutSummary: Semrush states that transactions lock 27 days after the transaction month's end and are paid 21 days after the end of the lock month. Impact withdrawals require at least $10 and completed payment requirements.
terms.eligibility: Last-click attribution and a new qualifying account are required. Existing accounts and missing tracking consent can prevent attribution. Applications are reviewed; the public content-publisher criterion includes 1,000 monthly unique visitors.
terms.adjustments: Invalid or unattributed actions do not generate normal commissions. Trial and higher-tier rewards are not included.

caveats: Two modeled months approximate transaction locking and payment; withdrawal settings and banking can add time.
The separate $10 qualifying-trial reward is excluded to avoid double-counting a paid conversion. Semrush One and other toolkits have different base payments.
An advertised maximum such as $450 is not the SEO Toolkit base commission used here.

benchmarks.summary: Reported $197.3 million of quarterly revenue and $4.3 million of GAAP net income. Its SMB revenue declined 11% year over year, primarily because of continued organic-search pressure.
benchmarks.caveat: A mature financial marketplace and guidance business with several financial-product categories, operations, and distribution channels. These are company results, not a software-affiliate conversion benchmark or a Seller Insider Hub earnings target.

benchmarks.summary: Its official investor highlights report £349.1 million of half-year revenue and £83.3 million of adjusted EBITDA, a 24% adjusted EBITDA margin. Revenue declined 8% year over year.
benchmarks.caveat: A diversified specialist-media group with advertising, subscriptions, ecommerce, and comparison businesses. Adjusted EBITDA is not net income; netIncome is intentionally null in this record. Different currencies and reporting periods must remain labeled. These figures do not establish a margin or growth forecast for a new publication.

evidenceNotes.topic: HubSpot commission duration and withdrawal minimum
evidenceNotes.finding: 30% recurring for up to one year; 180-day cookie; $10 withdrawal minimum. Public policies defer the lock duration and exact applicable offer to the affiliate tool.
30-day hold, $100 open balance, at least two different referrals, Friday settlement. These gates materially delay early cash compared with earned commissions.

The worked example includes the 31-day hold before the following review cycle. The separate FAQ compresses that explanation. The model uses an explicit approximation, rather than promising a precise payout date.
The selected model is SEO Toolkit's base $200 sale payment. Higher-tier maxima, other toolkit prices, and paid trial actions are separate.

Official search retrieval exposed the HY2026 highlights, while one open-page extraction showed the older FY2025 highlights. The separate official results page identifies HY2026 and its 24% adjusted margin. No FY2026 full-year forecast is presented as a realized result.
